title: Green synthesis of ice-templated lotus starch–bentonite cryogels for sustainable and energy-efficient VOC capture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46356-46366
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07007D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Huarong Liu, Hong Liu, Ning An, Kui Yang, Zhongwei Liu
A lotus starch–bentonite porous monolith, fabricated via green ice-templating, has a multi-porous structure and demonstrates polarity-driven VOC selectivity, enabling efficient capture and low-energy regeneration.
